claim: Costco's diluted EPS decreased 17% from the prior year in the 2024 fiscal year.
summary: Costco's FY2024 diluted EPS increased about 17% (to ~$16.56 from ~$14.16), not decreased. The 17% magnitude is approximately correct but the direction is opposite, so the claim of a 17% decrease is contradicted.

sub_claims.text: Costco's diluted EPS decreased from the prior year in fiscal 2024
sub_claims.note: From existing knowledge, Costco FY2024 diluted EPS was about $16.56 versus about $14.16 in FY2023, an increase, not a decrease.

sub_claims.text: The size of the year-over-year change was 17%
sub_claims.note: From existing knowledge, the change from ~$14.16 to ~$16.56 is about +17%, so 17% magnitude is approximately correct but as an increase.
